title: Skypark Elara Lakelands
shortDescription: Skypark Elara Lakelands is a low-rise seven-storey condominium within Laguna Lakelands, a residential community beside the Laguna Phuket resort.
description: Skypark Elara Lakelands is a low-rise seven-storey condominium within Laguna Lakelands, a residential community beside the Laguna Phuket resort. The first phase comprises three blocks with around 220 one-, two- and three-bedroom units. Facilities include a rooftop infinity-edge pool and a terrace with barbecue area. Owners can access Laguna Lakelands and Laguna Phuket community facilities.
